question: Identify the full names of the top three members who incurred the highest total expenses on 'Advertisement'-related budgets, among those who wear 'X-Large' t-shirts and hold positions other than 'Member'.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_035", T1."XCL_036"
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_022"
INNER JOIN budget AS T3 ON T2."XCL_023" = T3."XCL_003"
WHERE T3."XCL_004" = 'Advertisement'
  AND T1."XCL_039" = 'X-Large'
  AND T1."XCL_038" != 'Member'
GROUP BY T1."XCL_034", T1."XCL_035", T1."XCL_036"
ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_020") DESC
LIMIT 3
